{{Top|leg}}
A '''Pontite lens''' was a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] [[Focusing lens/Legends|focusing lens]] created using a [[Pontite crystal/Legends|Pontite]] crystal. Although the rare [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] was typically used as a focusing crystal, as a lens it was capable of cooling both skin and tempers.
